prompt: Add a deterministic Phase 5 repair probe that exercises the real bounded repair runtime without calling external services. Create scripts/repair_probe.py using only the standard library and ADE public APIs. The probe must inject a run_cycle_fn that raises CycleTimedOut on the first call and returns a valid CycleResult on the second call, then invoke run_cycle_with_repair with a bounded RepairPolicy. It must validate that exactly one RETRY plan is recorded, exactly two cycle calls occurred, the final result is COMPLETED, and no secret or traceback data is emitted. Print one compact JSON object on success and exit 0; exit nonzero with a concise message on invariant failure. Add focused unittest coverage for the probe helpers if you extract any. Do not add dependencies. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v and PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/repair_probe.py before finishing.
title: Add deterministic Phase 5 repair probe
